disclaimer: Provisional engineering thresholds for the QEVD-FIT front-view vertical slice. They are not medical standards and have not been calibrated against expert issue-level annotations.

confidence.rule: 0.35-0.55 keeps at most low severity; below 0.35 no issue card is emitted

knee_valgus_bottom.definition: maximum inward knee deviation from the hip-ankle coronal alignment; positive means medial

squat_depth_insufficient.title: 下蹲深度不足
squat_depth_insufficient.detail: {rep_phrase} 的膝关节屈曲 ROM 约 {value_text}，低于初版参考阈值。
squat_depth_insufficient.cue: 尝试在可控范围内再向下坐一些，同时保持膝盖朝向脚尖。

squat_asymmetry.title: 左右发力不对称

squat_asymmetry.cue: 放慢动作并关注两侧同时发力；若差异持续，建议降低负重或单侧辅助练习。

squat_tempo_inconsistent.title: 动作节奏不一致
squat_tempo_inconsistent.detail: 本组 rep 时长变异系数约 {value_text}，高于初版关注阈值 {threshold_text}；代表 rep 为第 {representative_rep_id} 个。
squat_tempo_inconsistent.cue: 用稳定的节拍完成每一次下蹲和起身，避免突然加速或停顿。
squat_tempo_inconsistent.disabled_detail: 本组完整 rep 少于 3 个，无法可靠评估节奏一致性。
